t: Våra värsta år: Buck Can Do It
d: Al is reluctant to have Buck neutered despite being threatened with lawsuits from numerous neighbors regarding Buck's "nocturnal carnal activities.”

t: Våra värsta år: Poppy's By The Tree - Pt 1
d: The Bundys take a vacation to near-beautiful Dumpwater, Florida and stay in a cut-rate motel where an ax murderer that hates tourists shows up every five years since 1967.

t: Våra värsta år: Poppy's By The Tree - Pt 2
d: After a hair-raising encounter with the maniac, Al decides to get the family out of town. But, they are trapped at the motel by a storm and the locals are unwilling to help them.

t: Våra värsta år: If I Were a Rich Man
st: If I Were a Rich Man
d: Steve takes Al to the vault at the bank where Steve works for a secret after-hours card game.  The next day, one million dollars is reported missing.

t: Våra värsta år: For Whom the Bell Tolls
d: Al gets heated up over the large phone bill and refuses to pay it. This results in the disconnection of the Bundy phone line and making him the target of hostility from Peggy, the kids and the Rhodes who now take the Bundys phone calls on their phone.

t: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1
st: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1
d: While Al and Steve are occupied by a female employee who fixes the Bundy's refrigerator, Peggy invites Marcy to a strip club with the girls.

t: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2
st: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2
d: Marcy loses her composure and wedding ring when it slips into a dancer's briefs while slipping him a tip. Desperate to keep the news from Steve, Marcy sets out to distract him every chance she gets.

t: Våra värsta år: Born to Walk
d: Al flunks his written drivers test the same day that Kelly passes hers, leading him confined to the house and unable to get to the racetrack to bet on an important horse race.

t: Våra värsta år: Alley of the Dolls
d: Victory seems assured when Steve agrees to join the Bundys for a family team bowling match against Peggy's arch rival from high school, Mimi, and her obnoxious family.

t: Våra värsta år: The Razor's Edge
d: Steve returns home having grown a beard from a week-long rafting trip. He and Marcy get into a huge argument over his reluctance to shave it off, leading him to move in with the Bundys.

t: Våra värsta år: How do You Spell Revenge?
d: Al, Peggy and Bud are part of a shopping mall softball team playing other mall teams. After losing a few too many games, Al demands that Peggy improve her softball skills or she is off his team.

t: Våra värsta år: Earth Angel
d: There's a new light in the neighborhood when Bud brings home an attractive, free spirited, 21-year-old artist named Tiffany on her way to art school in New York.  Everyone likes her, except Marcy, who thinks Tiffany steals the attentions of Steve.

t: Våra värsta år: You Better Watch Out
d: The Bundys' Christmas is rudely interrupted when a parachuting mall Santa crash-lands into their backyard, attracting the neighborhood kids.

t: Våra värsta år: Guys and Dolls
d: When starting a baseball card collection, Al and Steve sell Marcy's old Barbie doll. They must get it back, but learn that the shop they sold it to was robbed.

t: Våra värsta år: Build a Better Mousetrap
d: Al's attempts to get rid of a rodent in the Bundy house end badly.

t: Våra värsta år: Master the Possibilities
d: Al, under the impression that you don't have to pay for anything you didn't order, takes Peggy and Bud on a wild spending spree when the mailman accidentally leaves a new credit card addressed to Buck the dog.

t: Våra värsta år: Blonde and Blonder
d: On Valentines Day, Kelly hauls in a load of Valentines, while Steve plans to give Marcy a trip to Hawaii. When Marcy finds out from Peggy, she plans to give Steve his Valentine present by jumping out of a life-size cake.

t: Våra värsta år: The Great Escape
d: The Bundy's stay at the shoe store after their house is tented for termites. A grounded Kelly plots to escape and go to a rock concert.

t: Våra värsta år: Impo-Dent
d: Marcy regrets denting Steve's new car when he claims that she's made him impotent.

t: Våra värsta år: Just Married…with Children
d: While secretly going through Steve and Marcy's mail, Al and Peggy fill out an application to a TV game show called "How Do I Love Thee" where the objective is a Bundy natural: surviving physical torture from one's spouse.

t: Våra värsta år: Father Lode
d: After going with Steve to the racetrack, Al is reluctant to reveal that he won $1,200, because he knows that Peggy and the kids will take the money for themselves.

t: Våra värsta år: All in the Family
d: Al's quiet three-day weekend plans to watch his favorite John Wayne movie "Hondo" are ruined when Peggy's eccentric relatives come to visit the Bundy household.

t: Våra värsta år: The Camping Show (aka A Period Piece)
st: The Camping Show (aka A Period Piece)
d: Steve, Marcy and the Bundys head out to Steve and Marcy's cabin in the woods, but the merriment is halted by Kelly's PMS. The men leave for a bit to go out fishing, and return to all three women menstruating and hostile.

t: Våra värsta år: He Thought He Could
d: Al discovers a library book that was due in 1957. He must return it to the library and face up to his worst childhood fear: the librarian.

t: Våra värsta år: I'm Going to Sweatland
d: When a perspiration stain on one of Al's shirts resembles a silhouette of The King of Rock & Roll, the Bundy household becomes a hot spot for Elvis Presley fanatics to visit.

t: Våra värsta år: Poke High (aka The Red Grange Story)
st: Poke High (aka The Red Grange Story)
d: A young football player, named Matt, from Polk High where Kelly and Bud go to school is threatening two Bundy records. One held by Al for the most touchdowns in one season, and the other by Kelly for refusing her advances.

t: Våra värsta år: A Dump of My Own
d: Al decides to build a spare bathroom when the upstairs toilet floods one too many times.

t: Våra värsta år: Her Cups Runneth Over
d: Al must go to a far-off lingerie outlet store to buy a discontinued brassiere for Peggy.

t: Våra värsta år: The Bald and the Beautiful
d: Desperate Al and Steve put their heads together seeking solutions to impending baldness.

t: Våra värsta år: I'll See You in Court
d: In the infamous 'lost episode', Al and Peg learn they have been video-taped getting intimate at a sleazy motel. The same thing has also happened to Steve and Marcy. They decide to take the matter to court.

t: Våra värsta år: Gypsy Cried
d: After a birthday party fortune teller predicts luck for everyone else but doom for Marcy, she insists the Bundys fly with her on her business trip where she confronts her rude boss.

t: Våra värsta år: Requiem for a Dead Barber
d: After the death of his longtime barber, Al lets his hair down rather than tolerate a visit to a stylist or a salon... staffed by women. When Al backs down and goes to a salon, he gets a really bad hairstyle that makes him look like a woman.

t: Våra värsta år: Eatin' Out
d: The Bundy's go out to a fancy restaurant to spend an inheritance check for $237 from a late uncle of Peggy's. But it becomes apparent that the fine dining in public is not a part of the dysfunctional Bundy lifestyle.

t: Våra värsta år: My Mom, the Mom
d: Kelly invites Peggy to her school as part of a presentation for career day.

t: Våra värsta år: Can't Dance, Don't Ask Me (aka Kelly's Dance)
st: Can't Dance, Don't Ask Me (aka Kelly's Dance)
d: After Kelly gets in trouble at school, the only way she can get out of punishment if she joins the school's tap-dance club.

t: Våra värsta år: A Three Job, No Income Family
st: A Three Job, No Income Family
d: Al finally convinces Peggy to contribute to the household income but feels emasculated when Peggy starts bringing home more money than Al from her cosmetics sales job. Even Al's new part-time job at Burger Trek can't put him back as the breadwinner.

t: Våra värsta år: The Harder They Fall
d: While driving Peggy back from the video store, Steve gets cut off in traffic and Peggy gives the driver "the finger." The Bundys to come over to Steve’s house as protection when he's afraid of a violent reprisal after being followed home by the man.

t: Våra värsta år: The House That Peg Lost
d: After asking the Bundys to watch their house for the day, Marcy and Steve return to find a big hole where their house once stood.
